title: Make a Mob Farm
description: Adds recipes for spawners and (most) spawn eggs!
body:
This datapack adds a way for players to obtain (most) spawn eggs without the need for using Creative Mode, as well as adds recipes for both regular mob spawners and Trial Spawners to utilize the hostile mob eggs!

All spawn eggs use basic chicken eggs in all three colors (regular, blue, or brown), plus at least one item with some sort of connection to the mob, either their drops, what they require for breeding, or something otherwise associated with them.

<details>
  <summary>Passive or Neutral Spawn Eggs and Required Items</summary>

- Allay (Amethyst Shard)
- Armadillo (Armadillo Scute)
- Axolotl (Tropical Fish)
- Bat (Pointed Dripstone)
- Bee (Any small flower)
- Camel (Cactus Flower)
  - Camel Husk (Cactus Flower + Rotten Flesh)
- Cat (Raw Cod)
- Chicken (Wheat Seeds)
- Cow (Wheat)
  - Mooshroom (Red Mushroom)
- Dolphin (Pufferfish)
- Donkey (Golden Apple)
- Fox (Sweet Berries or Glow Berries)
- Frog (Lilypad)
- Goat (Goat Horn)
- Glow Squid (Glow Ink Sac)
- Horse (Apple)
  - Skeleton Horse (Apple + Bone)
  - Zombie Horse (Apple + Rotten Flesh)
- Llama (Hay Bale)
  - Trader Llama (Hay Bale + Emerald)
- Mule (Golden Carrot)
- Nautilus (Nautilus Shell)
- Ocelot (Raw Salmon)
- Panda (Bamboo)
- Parrot (Feather + Dye)
- Pig (Beetroot)
- Polar Bear (Snow Block)
- Rabbit (Rabbit Foot)
- Sheep (Wool)
- Sniffer (Torchflower Seeds)
- Strider (Warped Fungus)
- Squid (Ink Sac)
- Turtle (Turtle Scute)
- Villager (Emerald)
  - Wandering Trader (Emerald + Golden Apple)
- Wolf (Raw Beef, Porkchop, Mutton, Chicken, or Rabbit)
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Hostile Spawn Eggs and Required Items</summary>

- Blaze (Blaze Powder)
- Breeze (Breeze Rod)
- Creaking (Resin Clump)
- Creeper (Gunpowder)
- Enderman (Ender Pearl)
- Evoker (Enchanted Book)
- Ghast (Ghast Tear)
- Guardian (Prismarine Crystals)
  - Elder Guardian (Prismarine Shard)
- Hoglin (Crimson Fungus)
  - Zoglin (Crimson Fungus + Rotten Flesh)
- Phantom (Phantom Membrane)
- Piglin (Gold Nugget)
  - Piglin Brute (Gold Ingot)
  - Zombified Piglin (Gold Nugget + Rotten Flesh)
- Pillager (Crossbow)
- Ravager (Any banner + Iron Chain)
- Shulker (Chorus Fruit)
- Silverfish (Stone Bricks)
  - Endermite (Stone Bricks + Ender Pearl)
- Slime (Slimeball)
- Skeleton (Bone)
  - Bogged (Bone + both Red and Brown Mushrooms)
  - Parched (Bone + Sand)
  - Stray (Bone + Powder Snow Bucket)
  - Wither Skeleton (Bone + Coal)
- Spider (Spider Eye)
  - Cave Spider (Fermented Spider Eye)
- Vex (Amethyst Shard + Iron Sword)
- Vindicator (Iron Axe)
- Warden (Sculk)
- Witch (Potion)
- Zombie (Rotten Flesh)
  - Drowned (Rotten Flesh + Water Bucket)
  - Husk (Rotten Flesh + Sand)
  - Zombie Villager (Rotten Flesh + Emerald)
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Unavailable Spawn Eggs</summary>

- All Fish
- Copper Golem
- Ender Dragon
- Happy Ghast
- Iron Golem
- Snow Golem
- Sulfur Cube
- Tadpole
- Wither
</details>
